title: The Vanished Wooden Locomotive
intro: The prize-winning wooden locomotive has disappeared from the display shelf at the toy workshop just before the big open-day inspection.

suspects.name: Odin
suspects.line: The shelf was fine when I dusted it, honest.

suspects.name: Rosa
suspects.line: I was painting the tunnel set in the back room.

suspects.name: Teo
suspects.line: Trains? I only paint the tiny cows, thanks.

suspects.name: Pip
suspects.line: I only came in for the glue. That's all.

suspects.name: Marta
suspects.line: I was tightening bolts all afternoon. Ask anyone.

clues.text: The cocoa pot was still warm and full, and its drinker was seen sipping quietly the entire time, so the hot cocoa drinker is not the culprit.
The striped apron hanging on its hook has been cleared of suspicion: its owner was measuring timber in the yard the whole time, so it is not the culprit's.
A loose red bandana was left tangled on the workbench, the kind someone wears knotted at the neck while sanding and painting.
A sticky lemonade cup sat on the stand, but its owner was still pouring glasses for the queue, so the lemonade drinker is not the culprit.
